title: Scalar tensor comparisons on arbitrary semilinear squares
statement: For any diagram B of sheaves of commutative rings and the normalized scalar tensor comparisons, arbitrary semilinear square transitions commute with the signed direct-sum tensor total. On a homogeneous tensor summand, the forward composite inserts one in the second factor and transports the first coefficient through the square; the inverse composite multiplies the two transported coefficients. These formulas hold for unbounded complexes and arbitrary coefficient maps, without flatness.

source.place: Steps 5 and 6 of lem-pur-coefficient-comparisons-strict-totalization; Stacks 03EK, 03EL, 07A4, proof constituents.

proof.text: Obtain the forward and inverse ordinary scalar tensor formulas from the scalar construction in lem-pur-coefficient-comparisons-balanced-construction, using its uniqueness to identify the supplied normalized comparison. The coproduct-inclusion equations give these formulas on each homogeneous tensor summand. The proved scalar-associator calculations of [lem-pur-normalized-kappa-transition-calculus] multiply coefficients and insert one in the inverse, by scalar-extension adjoint uniqueness. Apply these formulas and the arbitrary semilinear adjoints in order; multiplicativity and unitality of ring morphisms identify the coefficients. For equality of whole maps, use the two scalar adjunctions, coproduct extensionality and the proved pure-tensor extensionality in lem-pur-independent-ringed-tensorator-existence. The zero and negative-degree cases obey the same formulas.
